correctness.rationale: For each a>1 the support-function proof gives 26 inequalities and 24 signed-permutation vertices with exactly four active facet normals. Independently reconstructed integer active normals at a=2. Every generic beam hits exactly 6 or 7 vertices by relative magnitudes and triangle inequalities, nongeneric beams cannot hit more by strict perturbation, so weight >=24/7. Independently checked all 48 signed permutations of (4,2,1) hit seven vertices each and each vertex exactly 14 times; the four stated directions cover all vertices. Active-normal structure analytically holds for all a>1, and the cube at a=1 needs eight. Finite a=2 checks corroborate, not replace, the continuum support-function argument.
